mechanisms.name: grain refinement by increased thermal supercooling

evidence.quote: The grain refining effect of C in Mo has been investigated in [ 17 , 18 , 22 ] and was attributed to increased thermal supercooling at the solid/liquid interface, owing to an increased lag of the S/L interface to the isothermal of the solidus temperature caused by the solute rejection effect of carbon

mechanisms.name: grain boundary purification by oxygen binding

evidence.quote: Two mechanisms ensure that the grain boundaries remain free of oxygen: the formation of ZrO2 nanoparticles and the dissolution of oxygen in the ternary (Mo, Ti) carbide.

The main reasons for this finding were likely to be the increased grain refinement with increasing carbon content, as well as the efficient grain boundary purification by the narrow, closed network of oxygen-gettering ternary (Mo, Ti) carbides.
